meta.name: agent-memory-mcp
meta.description: A hybrid memory system that provides persistent, searchable knowledge management for AI agents (Architecture, Patterns, Decisions).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为AI代理提供持久化、可搜索的知识记忆管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建需要长期记忆的AI代理系统
copy.tagline_en: Provide persistent, searchable knowledge memory for AI agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building AI agent systems that need long-term memory

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动读写和搜索长期记忆，比如保存架构决策、查找之前讨论过的模式，让对话更连贯。
howto.when: 当你需要记录或回顾项目中的知识、架构、模式或决策时触发。例如，保存一条新记忆或搜索已有记忆。

say.text: 保存这个认证架构决策，标记为“auth-v1”。
say.note: 会调用 memory_write 工具存储记忆。

say.text: 搜索所有关于“认证”的模式。
say.note: 会调用 memory_search 工具查找匹配的记忆。
会调用 memory_read 工具获取具体内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically read, write, and search long-term memories, such as saving architecture decisions or retrieving previously discussed patterns, making conversations more coherent.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to record or review project knowledge, architecture, patterns, or decisions. For example, saving a new memory or searching existing ones.

say_en.text: Save this authentication architecture decision, tag it as 'auth-v1'.
say_en.note: Calls memory_write tool to store the memory.
Calls memory_search tool to find matching memories.
Calls memory_read tool to retrieve specific content.
